key.name: primary-limit
key.description: "session": the current session; "weekly": the week's whole-account limit; each falls back to the highest. "highest": the limit closest to being used up.

key.name: show-percent
key.summary: Show the percentage beside the icon
key.description: With this off a button is its icon alone, tinted by how much has been used.

key.name: hide-unavailable
key.summary: Hide a button that has no figure to show
key.description: A provider that is signed out, whose stored login has expired or that could not be read has no button until it has a figure. It is still read, so the button returns by itself.

key.name: renew-login
key.summary: Renew an expired login by running the provider's tool
key.description: Once each time a login expires, runs the tool's own diagnostics command (claude doctor, codex doctor), which refreshes the login it stored. The extension still never refreshes a token itself.

key.name: reset-format
key.summary: How a reset time is worded
key.description: "auto": a countdown under a day away, then a weekday and time. "relative": the countdown. "absolute": the time. "both": the countdown, then the time in brackets.

key.name: panel-box
key.summary: Which end of the top bar the buttons sit at
key.description: "right" among the status icons, "center" beside the clock, "left" beside Activities.

key.name: panel-index
key.summary: Position within that end of the top bar
key.description: Where the first button goes: 0 is the end nearest the middle of the bar; -1 puts them last.

key.name: poll-seconds
key.description: Opening the pop-up, or the stored login changing, also reads the figures again.

key.name: warn-percent
key.summary: Percentage at which a limit counts as nearly used up

key.name: critical-percent
key.summary: Percentage at which a limit counts as almost gone

key.name: notify-percent
key.summary: Percentage at which to send a notification
key.description: 0 turns notifications off. Otherwise once per limit, until that limit resets.

key.name: enabled
key.description: Off, the provider is not read and has no button. A provider whose command-line tool is not installed is left out either way.

key.name: show-per-model
key.description: With this off only the whole-account limits are listed.

key.name: show-breakdown
key.description: A line naming which of the provider's surfaces the period's usage came from.

key.name: show-credits
key.description: Usage bought beyond the plan's limits, when the provider reports it.
